hooks.command: MODE=$(cat .claude/state/MODE 2>/dev/null); echo '{"additionalContext": "Branch: '$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo detached)' | Last: '$(git log --oneline -1 2>/dev/null || echo none)'${MODE:+ | Previous AcePilot mode: '$MODE' (run /acepilot resume to continue)}'"}'

f="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; case "${f##*.}" in py) ruff format "$f" 2>/dev/null || black -q "$f" 2>/dev/null;; rs) rustfmt "$f" 2>/dev/null;; go) gofmt -w "$f" 2>/dev/null;; *) npx prettier --write "$f" 2>/dev/null;; esac; true

echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE 'rm -rf|rm -r /|rm -r \.|DROP TABLE|DROP DATABASE|git push.*--force|git push.*-f |git reset --hard|git checkout -- \.|git clean -fd|chmod 777|curl.*\|.*bash|wget.*\|.*bash|sudo |mkfs|> /dev/sd' && echo 'BLOCKED: Dangerous pattern' >&2 && exit 2 || exit 0

TS=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S); mkdir -p .claude/backups; for f in .claude/state/TASKS.md .claude/state/DECISIONS.md .claude/state/CONTEXT.md .claude/state/KNOWLEDGE.md .claude/state/USER-KNOWLEDGE.md .claude/state/PATTERNS.md .claude/state/MODE .claude/state/CIRCUIT .claude/state/STASH_REF; do [ -f "$f" ] && cp "$f" ".claude/backups/$(basename "$f")-$TS.bak"; done; echo 'State backed up'

MODE=$(cat .claude/state/MODE 2>/dev/null); TASK=$(grep -m1 '\- \[ \]' .claude/state/TASKS.md 2>/dev/null | head -1); DONE=$(grep -cE '- \[x\]|- \[~\]' .claude/state/TASKS.md 2>/dev/null || echo 0); TOTAL=$(grep -c '- \[' .claude/state/TASKS.md 2>/dev/null || echo 0); echo '{"additionalContext": "POST-COMPACTION STATE RECOVERY: Mode: '${MODE:-none}' | Progress: '$DONE'/'$TOTAL' tasks | Current: '${TASK:-none}' | CRITICAL: Re-read .claude/state/TASKS.md before continuing. Verify current task ID matches. Do not skip the Qualify step."}'
